notes: Mitsui & Co. is NOT a shareholder; the third shareholder (June 2024) is Mitsubishi Corporation. The stake and amount are undisclosed, and paid-in capital still reads JPY 310M afterwards, consistent with a share transfer or a capital-reserve booking rather than a disclosed new round.
Renamed from Preferred Computational Chemistry to Matlantis Corporation on 2025-07-01; the US subsidiary PFCC Inc. (Cambridge, MA, opened 2024-09) became Matlantis Inc.
PFN's own staff developed PFP; much of the R&D sits inside PFN, so Matlantis headcount (46) understates the people working on the product.
Only one dated headcount was found. Wayback CDX on matlantis.com company pages timed out (shared Wayback budget), and the BizReach listing returned 403. LinkedIn and OpenAlex were skipped for time.
